title: Oban: job_finished
description: An Oban job finished, whether it succeeded or failed. Emitted for both oban.job.stop and oban.job.exception telemetry events.

state.description: Resulting job state: "completed", "retryable", "discarded", "cancelled", or "scheduled" (snoozed). Failures are "retryable" until max_attempts is exhausted, then "discarded".

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of attempts before the job is discarded.

queue_time.description: Time the job spent waiting in the queue (scheduled_at to attempted_at) in milliseconds.

error_type.description: Exception class name. Only present when the job failed (state "retryable" or "discarded").

error_message.description: Exception message. Only present when the job failed (state "retryable" or "discarded").

args.description: Job arguments (filtered). Only present when include_args is enabled in insights_config.

meta.description: Job metadata (filtered). Only present when include_args is enabled in insights_config.

request_id.description: Request ID propagated from the originating request's event context via Oban job metadata.
